Container.Name: ollama-queue
Container.Overview: The job queue: daemon, dashboard and API (port 7684), CPU job lane, event log and watchers, run by supervisord. Fixed LAN identity via br0 (IP in the Network field, MAC in Extra Parameters). State, locks and the sqlite lane store need a real local filesystem: use the cache pool, never /mnt/user. The daemon needs up to 60 s to stop cleanly, hence the stop timeout.

Config.Name: Standby
Config.Description: 1 = standby: only the API runs on a copy of the Mac state, write routes answer 503, nothing notifies. Set 0 and restart to go live.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Container time zone, for example Area/City. The log-rotate job runs at 04:17 in it.

Config.Name: Git author name
Config.Description: Name on commits the workers make.

Config.Name: Git author email
Config.Description: Email on commits the workers make.

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Fine-grained token limited to the target repos (contents: write). Clone and push use it.

Config.Name: Darkbloom base URL
Config.Description: Darkbloom local API on the Mac, http://MAC-LAN-IP:8000.

Config.Name: Darkbloom API key
Config.Description: Key for the Darkbloom local API.

Config.Name: Queue agent URL
Config.Description: Mac status service, http://MAC-LAN-IP:7691.

Config.Name: Queue agent token
Config.Description: Bearer token for the Mac status service.

Config.Name: Queue API token
Config.Description: Bearer token for the API's write routes. The Mac clients send the same token.

Config.Name: CPU runner token
Config.Description: Shared token the CPU runners use. Written to ~/.config/dispatch-cpu-runner/token at start.

Config.Name: Obsidian token
Config.Description: Obsidian Local REST API token for the vault dispatch log (optional).

Config.Name: Tavily key
Config.Description: Tavily search key (optional).

Config.Name: Brave search key
Config.Description: Brave search key (optional).

Config.Name: Ollama web search key
Config.Description: Ollama hosted web-search bearer (optional).

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Queue API and dashboard.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: State JSON, locks, queue logs. Cache pool only (flock).

Config.Name: Dispatch data
Config.Description: Chain runs, escalations, CPU lane sqlite and blobs, hosts.json. Cache pool only (sqlite WAL).

Config.Name: Worktrees
Config.Description: Job worktrees. Large; git needs a real filesystem.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: API and supervisord logs.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds config.toml (hosts, addresses, names).
